title: Project listings put popularity in view
summary:
Project discovery gained star counts and a new community image app, while text conversations got less repetitive.

GitHub star counts were added beside repository links, and project listings were reordered to put more-starred projects first. Counts of 1,000 or more appear in abbreviated form.

@narendradwivedi’s ImageGen AI Image was added to the creative-app listings. Separately, the project CSV was changed to put older submissions before newer ones; that ordering is distinct from the star-sorted listings.

Text conversations now skip another ad when their history already contains a Pollinations redirect link, including during streaming. The existing Mistral Small 3 model also changed provider routing, and image-generation response data no longer includes the requester’s IP address.

daily.title: Find popular community projects
daily.text: Project listings now show GitHub star counts and put more-starred projects first, making it easier to find what others are building. [Explore community apps](https://pollinations.ai).
